text:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: spike in inference-serving 5xxs triggering PagerDuty. 130 alerts in last 5m. link: https://console.redwood.example/alerts/2821234567
oncall-eric: Seeing the flood. I'm taking the first responders. Starting live mitigation now. Assessing customer impact.
support-jamie: Customers reporting 502s on large-file uploads — mostly EU region. Opening a customer thread and collecting request ids.
sre-lena: Suggest temporary measures: 1) PD rate-limit/squelch for this alert 2) group by service+error to reduce dupes 3) short-term routing fallback to smaller model variant for EU.
platform-alex: I'll apply a dedupe/group rule and a 1/min PD throttle for the alert. Pasting command I'm going to run:```bash
# apply PD suppression for 1 hour
redwood-pdctl suppress --service inference-serving --alert-name "5xx-spike" --rate 1/m --duration 60m
# set grouping key
redwood-alerts update-rule --id 2821 --group-by "service,error_code"
```
oncall-eric: Go for it @alex. I'll monitor pages and customer thread.
pd-integration: Suppression applied (rule id: SUP-2026). Grouping key updated. Expected PD pages drop within 30s.
oncall-eric: Confirming pages down to 2/min now, previously ~50/min. Huge improvement :thumbsup:.
sre-lena: Good. For post-incident: we should change the alerting signal. Current rule is "count>10 in 5m" which fires on noisy bursts. Propose changing to a rate metric + sustained window: e.g., 5xx_rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m AND p95 latency > 300ms. Also add a rolling 10m grouping window.
platform-alex: Noted. Current dedupe window is 30s; will propose 10m in the follow-up ticket. That reduces PD fanout but keeps visibility.
support-jamie: Adding customer impact notes to the ticket: customer org ids, sample request ids, timeframe, and affected region.
sre-lena: I'll create a tracker: SRE-4239. Owner: @sre-lena. Tasks: adjust thresholds, add new per-region dashboard, add small model fallback test, run rca on root cause, update runbook.
oncall-eric: Handoff: I'm ending my shift at 12:30UTC. Leaving context in the ticket and in #incidents summary. If pages resurge, remove suppression and escalate to infra pager.
platform-alex: Also adding a dashboard panel showing alert fanout (unique PD dedupe keys) + tokenized alerts/sec so we can tune dedupe thresholds empirically. Snippet for new alert:```yaml
alert: InferenceServiceHigh5xxRate
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[1m])) > 0.005
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "5xx rate >0.5% for 3m in {{ $labels.region }}"
```
sre-lena: Long-term recommendation: instrument request tracing at the ingress for large file uploads and add a synthetic test that uploads a 10MB file every 15m to detect regressions before customers hit them.
support-jamie: Will reach out to affected customers with the mitigation summary and ETA for follow-up.
pd-integration: Suppression SUP-2026 will auto-expire at UTC 13:15. Manual revoke allowed: `redwood-pdctl suppress --revoke SUP-2026`.
oncall-eric: Thanks all. Creating a short incident summary in #incidents and linking SRE-4239. Leaving handoff notes now.
incident-bot: Incident thread archived. Severity: SEV3. Pages reduced after mitigation.
sre-lena: Follow-up meeting scheduled: tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Agenda: tune dedupe/windowing, alert signal redesign, dashboard ownership.
platform-alex: I'll own the dashboard tile and the dedupe config change PR.
sre-lena: Assigning action items in the ticket. Closing thread here. :eyes:
